user.title: Love it or Loathe it
user.description: Choose the media players to watch, one or several. After this, add your groups of songs and the stations to switch to on the integration's page. To give other players different groups or stations, add the integration again.

data.name: Name
data.players: Media players to watch (one or more)

data_description.players: Any player that reports the title of what it is playing. Choose as many as you like: after the first, the box offers another. For speakers playing as one group, only the group's leader acts.
data_description.delay: Seconds to wait after a player reports a new track before acting. Leave it at 0 unless the title changes before the song does.
data_description.name: Shown on its device and entities. It matters when you add the integration more than once.

error.player_taken: One of those players is already watched by another Love it or Loathe it entry. Two entries acting on one player would undo each other's work.

data.players: Media players to watch (one or more)

data_description.players: Any player that reports the title of what it is playing. Choose as many as you like: after the first, the box offers another. For speakers playing as one group, only the group's leader acts.
data_description.delay: Seconds to wait after a player reports a new track before acting. Leave it at 0 unless the title changes before the song does.

error.player_taken: One of those players is already watched by another Love it or Loathe it entry. Two entries acting on one player would undo each other's work.

user.title: A group of songs
user.description: Start with an empty list and type the songs in, or start from a shipped list. A shipped list is put into the Songs box on the next screen, and from then on the songs are yours to add to and cut.

songs.title: A group of songs
songs.description: Songs you love or loathe, and what to do when one comes on. The group gets a switch of its own, so an automation can turn it on and off.

data_description.patterns: One per line: a title, or a title and an artist as Title | Artist. Use * for anything, for example *love* or * | Cliff Richard. Capitals and punctuation don't matter. A line with no * beats a line with one, whichever group it is in, so one song can be kept out of another group's *christmas*.
data_description.amount: For Change the volume: a percentage of the volume at the time, so 10 turns it up a tenth and -50 halves it. It is put back at the next track.
data_description.minutes: For Switch station: how long to stay away before going back.

error.bad_pattern: A line of nothing but * would match every song. Remove it or add a title or an artist.
error.no_stations: Add a station to switch to first, from the integration's page.

user.title: A station to switch to
user.description: Somewhere to go when a loathed song comes on. Stations are tried in the order they were added, skipping the one that is playing.

data_description.media: Choose a player to browse on, then the station. The station is then played on whichever player needs it.

options.volume: Change the volume until the next track

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Love it or Loathe it

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Love it or Loathe it integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
